causebase_summary: ACC TAS MINISTRIES LTD (operating as Youth Alive Tas on its website) appears on the ACNC register and filed an ACNC Information Statement for 2023. The organisation’s website states, as an organisation-authored claim, that “Youth Alive exists so that every young person in Australia lives their full God purpose.” The observed website homepage includes a visible email subscription prompt (“Sign up with your email address to receive news and updates”) and a labelled section heading “OUR PARTNERS”; no partners were named in the captured excerpt. The ACNC AIS 2023 extract reported revenue of AUD 88,470 and total expenses of AUD 82,490 for the 2023 reporting year. The publicly available excerpts and the ACNC extract provide financial and basic identity information but do not describe specific programs, service delivery activities, staff or volunteer roles, beneficiary numbers, or geographic operating sites beyond the organisation-authored statement about young people in Australia.
